raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MEX-SustainableValueChains",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Concentrated banking system and conservative risk appetite among Mexican financial institutions may limit PFIs' willingness to extend long-term green loans to SMEs, constraining sub-loan uptake.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted technical assistance and training to PFI teams under Component 2, blend concessional CCEFCF funding to lower capital costs, and establish clear eligibility guidelines.",
      "evidence": "a concentrated banking system with conservative risk appetite, weak competition, short-term funding structures... constrain financial access."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "SMEs and mid-caps lack internal technical capacity to measure emissions, formulate Sustainability Plans, and establish MRV systems, threatening sub-loan eligibility and target verification.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy Component 2 technical assistance to support firms in preparing Sustainability Plans, conducting feasibility assessments, and building internal MRV capacities.",
      "evidence": "Most Mexican firms lack the capacity to measure emissions, implement energy-use, generation or management systems, and comply with reporting frameworks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Superficial or unchallenging sustainability performance targets set in firm Sustainability Plans could lead to greenwashing and reputational damage for the project.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate independent ex-ante validation of Sustainability Plans and ex-post verification of KPI performance by qualified third-party validation entities.",
      "evidence": "To mitigate the risk of greenwashing, targets and results in the SP will be subject to, respectively, ex-ante validation and ex-post verification"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Providing local currency sub-loans while borrowing foreign currency funds exposes NAFIN to foreign exchange volatility risk.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Require NAFIN to manage foreign exchange risk on its balance sheet utilizing Mexico's currency swap market and restrict USD lending to firms with clear natural export hedges.",
      "evidence": "NAFIN will manage the FX risk on its own balance sheet using Mexico’s well developed currency swap market."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Subprojects financed through PFIs or direct lending may generate adverse environmental and social impacts if E&S risk management standards are inadequately applied.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce NAFIN's ESMS due diligence, apply a strict Exclusion List excluding high E&S risk activities, and conduct World Bank sample reviews and biannual performance reporting.",
      "evidence": "Environmental and Social (E&S) risk is assessed as Substantial, considering the nature of the financial instruments to be used"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "NAFIN's lack of direct experience executing World Bank procurement selection processes could lead to implementation delays for Component 2 contracts.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint a dedicated internal procurement specialist to the project team and deliver hands-on training and implementation support from the World Bank.",
      "evidence": "while NAFIN staff are familiar with the World Bank Procurement Regulations, they have not been directly involved in carrying out selection and contracting processes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Reliance on NAFIN's legacy information systems requiring manual data consolidation creates risk of operational errors and financial reporting delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear FM workflows and detailed PFI reporting rules in the Project Operations Manual, backed by supervisory reviews and targeted internal and external audits.",
      "evidence": "efficiency constraints arising from reliance on legacy information systems requiring manual consolidation, the need to consistently apply financial intermediary–specific controls"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Severe weather events, drought, and extreme heatwaves could disrupt beneficiary enterprise operations, leading to liquidity shortages and sub-loan defaults.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Target project investments toward climate resilience, energy efficiency, and water-saving technologies, while integrating climate risk assessments into subproject appraisal.",
      "evidence": "BEs could be slightly impacted by heat‑related productivity losses, water scarcity or energy‑supply disruptions."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "High upfront costs, complex paperwork, and expensive MRV requirements could deter prospective SME borrowers from applying for project-supported loans.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize ESMAP grant funds to cover ex-ante validation and verification costs during initial rollout and provide standardized templates to minimize administrative burden.",
      "evidence": "high Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs and limited capacity to structure, appraise and monitor investments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Persistent structural and social barriers faced by female-led businesses in Mexico could prevent women entrepreneurs from accessing project credit lines.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Execute a targeted gender-focused communication campaign, apply transparent access criteria for women-inclusive enterprises, and track progress via dedicated gender indicators.",
      "evidence": "women-led businesses face persistent barriers to financing: only 46 percent have ever sought credit compared to 50 percent of firms nationally"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Delays in preparing and formally adopting the Project Operations Manual and Sustainable Finance Framework could push back project effectiveness and initial disbursements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Leverage GFPP preparation grant resources to complete and finalize the POM and Sustainable Finance Framework prior to loan effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "Additional Conditions of Effectiveness consist of... the Borrower has adopted the Project Operations Manual... and prepared and adopted the Sustainable Finance Framework"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Credit defaults by direct mid-cap borrowers or second-tier participating financial institutions could cause financial losses for NAFIN.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce rigorous financial soundness criteria for PFIs and BEs, set single-borrower exposure limits, and include credit risk margins in on-lending interest rates.",
      "evidence": "NAFIN will assume the credit risk of the BEs when lending directly and of the PFIs on second-tier operations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Increasing global and domestic sustainability disclosure mandates may result in forward-exclusion of Mexican SME suppliers from global value chains if adoption of green practices is delayed.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate that at least 50 percent of GHG reductions under SLLs and 40 percent of GL proceeds target clean energy and energy efficiency investments, supporting rapid compliance.",
      "evidence": "Global and domestic regulatory and disclosure requirements... are prompting large anchor companies to assess the environmental performance of their suppliers"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Concentrated banking system and conservative risk appetite among Mexican financial institutions may limit PFIs' willingness to extend long-term green loans to SMEs, constraining sub-loan uptake.
risks.mitigation: Provide targeted technical assistance and training to PFI teams under Component 2, blend concessional CCEFCF funding to lower capital costs, and establish clear eligibility guidelines.
risks.evidence: a concentrated banking system with conservative risk appetite, weak competition, short-term funding structures... constrain financial access.

risks.description: SMEs and mid-caps lack internal technical capacity to measure emissions, formulate Sustainability Plans, and establish MRV systems, threatening sub-loan eligibility and target verification.
risks.mitigation: Deploy Component 2 technical assistance to support firms in preparing Sustainability Plans, conducting feasibility assessments, and building internal MRV capacities.
risks.evidence: Most Mexican firms lack the capacity to measure emissions, implement energy-use, generation or management systems, and comply with reporting frameworks
